class.name: MIDIEvent
class.brief_description: Base resource representing a decoded MIDI event.
class.description:
MIDIEvent is the base class for decoded MIDI events. It stores the MIDI channel and the delta time associated with an event.
The delta value represents the time elapsed since the preceding event in the MIDI track. Its interpretation depends on the timing information stored in the MIDI file.
This class provides a common interface for channel voice events, system events, and metadata events through its derived classes [MIDIEventNote], [MIDIEventSystem], and [MIDIEventMeta].

members.member: The MIDI channel associated with the event. System and metadata events use channel 0.
The time elapsed since the preceding event in the track, expressed in the timing units used by the MIDI data.
